question: What is the vision of the organization as stated in the policy manual?
ground_truth: To serve as a reliable product development partner for legislators who want to make systems of governance more open, more accessible, and more effective. Our products are iteratively built to address meaningful well-known problems in new, innovative ways

question: How often is payroll administered and on what dates?
ground_truth: Administered twice monthly, on the 15th and last day of each month, via direct deposit.

question: What percentage of the health and dental insurance premium cost does the company pay?
ground_truth: The company pays 80% of the premium cost of the plan.

question: What minimum percentage of its planned operating budget does the organization set aside to fund professional development activities?
ground_truth: The organization will endeavor to set aside an amount equal to 2.0% (at minimum) of its planned operating budget to fund professional development activities.

question: What is the maximum duration specified for daily standup meetings?
ground_truth: To better coordinate organizational or product development efforts, one or more daily standups may be scheduled, each lasting no longer than 15 minutes.
